$comment: Rules for the MCP gate in front of the Kiteworks MCP server (kiteworks-mcp 0.9.5). Start the gate with --name kiteworks and DELIVERD_HOOK_RULES pointing here. Kiteworks decides whether the data may move; these rules make the actions that send, share, delete or administer wait for a person's yes first. Reads, searches, mail drafts (compose_email), new folders and forms pass straight through. The last rule catches any write tool a later Kiteworks release adds, so a new tool is checked until you say otherwise. Edit, then run register.mjs with DELIVERD_HOOK_RULES set to this file.

rules.name: Send mail or a file request from Kiteworks
Change who can open files in Kiteworks
Delete files, folders or a mailbox in Kiteworks
Put, copy or move files in Kiteworks
Change Kiteworks users, profiles, mailboxes or policy
